Name: Fish Pond Dye
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This mods adds several (well, technically, practically [i]infinite[/i]) dye options for your fish ponds. Some fish change the water colour on their own, but the dyes in this mod will let you choose whatever colour you want for the water and do it [b]on a per-pond basis[/b]. That means you can have two ponds that both have the same fish in them be completely different colours, if you want.

The dyes can be bought from Willy's shop once you've built a fish pond anywhere in the world and cost 50 gold each (a configurable price). The 7 types of dye you can buy are Prismatic, Red, Orange, Green, Blue, Purple, and Custom. Here's an example of what tossing Orange dye into a pond looks like:

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/StardewBTN/refs/heads/main/FishPondDye/Promo/Preview1.gif[/img]

Prismatic dye will make your fish pond change colour over time, much like prismatic clothing. Some aspects of the prismatic pond behaviour are configurable, so please see the configuration section below if you're interested in changing it. Here's a preview of what applying Prismatic dye to your pond looks like:

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/StardewBTN/refs/heads/main/FishPondDye/Promo/Preview2.gif[/img]

Finally, if you're not happy with Prismatic dye or any of the other colour presets, you can apply Custom dye to your fish pond. When you go to toss Custom dye into your fish pond, a colour picker menu will open up (it has controller support!) that will let you choose whatever colour you want, down to the exact RGB values. When you confirm your colour choice, the dye will be tossed into the pond and it will become that colour. Here's what the menu looks like:

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/StardewBTN/refs/heads/main/FishPondDye/Promo/Preview3.png[/img]

These custom dyes will override any other colours applied to your pond, including the colours that certain fish already provide (e.g. if you have a Slimejack in your fish pond, these dyes will override the green colour that would normally appear). If you ever want to remove the dye from your pond, you'll need to drop in some Dye Remover, which can also be bought from Willy's shop. This will turn your pond back into the default water colour. Any colours that should be applied from the fish inside the pond will then be applied overnight.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b]
Use[b] [/b]Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the following options:
[list]
[*]Dye Price: How much the dye (and dye remover) should cost in Willy's shop. Default is 50.[/*]
[*]Prismatic Speed: A multiplier applied to the default speed determining how fast a prismatically-dyed pond will shift through the prismatic colours. Default is 1.[/*]
[*]Prismatic Sync: This setting determines how different prismatically-dyed ponds have their colours synchronized. Default is "Random." The available settings are as follows:
[list=1]
[*]Synchronized: Every prismatically-dyed pond will be the same colour as every other prismatically-dyed pond. They will change colours in sync with each other.[/*]
[*]Random: Each prismatically-dyed pond will have a randomly chosen prismatic colour it starts from, meaning none of them will (intentionally) be synchronized with any other.[/*]
[*]X Coordinate: The starting prismatic colour is determined by the pond's left-to-right position on the map. Ponds that are in a direct vertical line will have the same colours, and ponds to the left or right of them will not (though the immediate horizontal neighbours will be similar).[/*]
[*]Y Coordinate: The starting prismatic colour is determined by the pond's top-to-bottom position on the map. Ponds that are in a direct horizontal line will have the same colours, and ponds to the top or bottom of them will not (though the immediate vertical neighbours will be similar).[/*]
[*]X and Y Coordinate: Both the left-to-right and top-to-bottom positions of the pond will determine the starting colour. This means that, in contrast to the left/right or top/bottom neighbours of the "X Coordinate" and "Y Coordinate" settings respectively, this setting applies the same behaviour to [i]diagonal[/i] neighbours.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][url=https://github.com/Spiderbuttons/StardewBTN/tree/main/ThePhoneIsRinging][/url][color=#ffffff][size=4][url=https://github.com/Spiderbuttons/StardewBTN/tree/main/FishPondDye]Source Code[/url][/size][/color]
